CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (positions for p0/current/n0 red), its presentation/organization (explicit position listing), and a distinct origin/status field are all present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to an identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with named attributes (e.g. 'red') and position listings are present.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status field separates provenance/status from the content position listing for the same referent.

O.rationale: The reported explicit position listing shows how the identified content is presented/organized at the stated time.
